sources.note: Describes Ma Manda, not Nimi. pp. 27-30: survey of Erap sources; Table 2 lists for 'Sama' (= Nimi [nis]) only 'Hiley et al. 2008 - sociolinguistic survey report & wordlist'; p. 27: SIL-internal surveys 'are the only information that I am aware of for Nema, Mungkip, Nakame, Sama, and Nuk'; Erap-wide OPD summary (Nek/Numanggang/Uri/Finongan, not Nimi): 'stress is analyzed in various ways in various languages: quantity-sensitive, quality-sensitive, word-initial, contrastive, and unpredictable.'
